$help: Windows Terminal JSON fragment (the counterpart of iterm/profile-dynamic.json). Linked by install.ps1 into %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Windows Terminal/Fragments/dotfiles/. Terminal only reads fragments, so unlike its settings.json this file never gets rewritten under us.

profiles.$help: PowerShell 7 (the dynamic profile Terminal generates for pwsh; its GUID is fixed). The Nerd Font is what renders starship/starship.toml's glyphs.
